input_evidence.summary: #9843 [Automation] native-image run fails for org.flywaydb:flyway-sqlserver:13.5.0; label=fails-native-image-run; body_chars=8015

risks: Issue log is truncated before the actual failure line, so the real cause of the native-image run failure (likely a metadata coverage gap from new code paths in 13.5.0) should be confirmed by running checkMetadataFiles/test locally rather than assumed from this research alone.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: flyway-sqlserver is a thin driver over flyway-core with no new runtime deps in 13.5.0; the existing scaffold (mssql-jdbc + already-allow-listed mssql/server Docker image) already covers versions 12.3.0-13.4.0 unchanged, and 13.5.0's only notable change (optional jackson-databind, JSON moved to flyway-core-utilities) isn't exercised by the test.
